purpose: Complete descriptive external risk experiments for the frozen v0.4 selective screener without model fitting, threshold tuning, or claim expansion.
primary_analysis_population: Biogen_Fang_2023 identity-clean unique-connectivity rows with usable probability and frozen ER>=2 label
sensitivity_population: Biogen_Fang_2023 scaffold-clean unique-connectivity rows with usable probability and frozen ER>=2 label
frozen_label: MDR1-MDCK efflux ratio >= 2; a weak external efflux-risk label rather than universal ABCB1 substrate truth

probability_margin_coverage_reliability.description: Descriptive confidence-ranked retention curve based only on absolute distance from 0.5; no operating point will be selected from the external outcome.

rejector_rule_ablation.leave_one_out_scope: Remove one downstream rule family from the otherwise full rule set; the probability-margin rule remains mandatory.
rejector_rule_ablation.required_validation: The reconstructed full rule set must exactly reproduce the frozen v0.4 accepted rows and directions in the identity-clean population.

error_stratification.note: Abstention reasons can overlap; their rows are descriptive and are not summed as mutually exclusive counts.

cluster_bootstrap.unit: Murcko scaffold, with acyclic connectivity fallback inherited from bootstrap_cluster

interpretation_rules.allowed: External weak-label risk ranking, coverage-reliability trade-off, and enrichment of reliable calls under selective rejection.
interpretation_rules.not_allowed: Calling this analysis preregistered, choosing thresholds from these outcomes, claiming universal ABCB1 substrate classification, intact-ADC transport, intracellular unbound exposure, resistance, efficacy, or clinical DDI.
